# Source register

The dated source register of GOV-01, from the citations in requirements document version 1.3 and its §15 source list. There is one row per source and cited paragraph, box or section, so a range such as ¶123–125 takes three rows. Every value comes from the requirements file.

- **Local approval date** shows a date only if `docs/source-register/source-approvals.yaml` records one, otherwise "not approved".
- **Affected requirement IDs** lists the requirements that cite the row. A section number (§) means the citation sits in that section of the requirements with no ID.
- Whether a paragraph has been checked against the source PDF is not in this table: see §15 of the requirements and C8 in `docs/assumptions.md`.

No local approval is recorded. `docs/implementation-status.md` records that the June 2026 draft and synthetic examples were authorised on 30 October 2026, "not official compliance or bank-approved calibration". That is permission to prepare against the draft, not approval of a source, so it is not shown as a date here.

To assess a change to a source, use [the GOV-03 template](gov-03-impact-assessment-template.md).
